business_problem: Eni wanted to improve drilling efficiency, consistency, and safety in well planning and offshore drilling operations by defining better operating limits and reducing rework, human error, and hazardous rig-floor exposure.
solution_summary: Eni implemented an SLB digital drilling workflow that combined planning, AI-assisted execution, and automation for offshore well delivery. In the planning stage, DrillPlan coherent well planning and engineering solutions were used to capture drilling constraints for each parameter and iteratively define the operational window or envelope, allowing suboptimal designs that needed re-engineering to be identified earlier. During execution, DrillOps intelligent well delivery and insights solutions used the defined envelopes to recommend and apply optimal drilling parameters and to autonomously manage drilling phases. On the rig floor, DrillPilot equipment sequencing software coordinated multiple machines in an optimized sequence, while Neuro autonomous solutions provided autonomous steering and broader automation support. The deployment was used in Eni's first fully autonomous offshore West Africa operation in Q1 2024. The source describes an execution-oriented control stack rather than a distinct named storage tier.
